author: Ryan Shirley
description:
The Seychelles is the true definition of paradise. Enjoy this travel guide featuring my favorite places in the Seychelles. From the unique granite rocks of Anse Source d’Argent, to the crystal clear waters of Anse Lazio, the Seychelles is waiting to be experienced. I just returned from exploring the islands of the Seychelles for a week and can’t wait to share this video with you. Where is your favorite place in the Seychelles?
